title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship
summary: Seven categories: research students, teacher training, undergraduate, Japanese studies, college of technology, specialized training college and Young Leaders Program. Tuition is exempted and airfare is provided.
eligibility: Undergraduate applicants must be under 25 and research students under 35. Apply through the Japanese embassy in your country or through a university approved by MEXT.
opens: Each Japanese embassy sets its own deadline. Check your embassy

title: Rotary Yoneyama Scholarship for overseas applicants
summary: Monthly scholarship of 100,000 yen for undergraduates and 140,000 yen for master's and doctoral students, plus a travel subsidy of up to 250,000 yen for the flight to Japan.
eligibility: Open to people living overseas who plan to study at a Japanese university. JLPT N3 or higher is required at the time of application. Research students are not eligible.
opens: The 2027 entry call closed on 31 October 2026. See the official page for the next call

title: JASSO Student Exchange Support Program
summary: Monthly stipend of 80,000 yen for students on short-term exchange in Japan, from 8 days to one year, under an agreement between their home university and a Japanese school.
eligibility: Applications are accepted only from the Japanese school, not from individual students. Ask your home university's international office.
opens: Set by the Japanese host school. Ask your exchange office

title: Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship for Privately-Financed International Students
summary: JASSO scholarship for privately-financed international students in Japan. Amounts, eligibility and how to apply are on the official page.
eligibility: See the official page.
opens: See the official page

title: Global Korea Scholarship for undergraduate degrees (GKS-U)
summary: Covers airfare, Korean language training, tuition and a monthly allowance. One year of language training, then 4 to 6 years for a bachelor's degree.
eligibility: Applicants must be under 25 years of age. Apply through the Embassy Track on Study in Korea or directly to a GKS university.
opens: Every September. Embassy Track in September, University Track from September to November

title: Global Korea Scholarship for graduate degrees (GKS-G)
summary: Two years for a master's degree and three years for a doctoral degree, in Korea.
eligibility: Applicants must be under 40 years of age. Apply to the Korean embassy in your country or to a GKS-designated university.
opens: Every year, February to March

title: Google Summer of Code
summary: A global, online program that brings new contributors into open source. You work with an open source organization on a 12+ week programming project with mentor guidance.
eligibility: Aimed at people new to open source. See the official page for the current rules.
opens: Once a year. See the program timeline on the official page

title: Outreachy open source internships
summary: Paid, remote open source internships. Interns receive a total of 7,000 USD. Two cohorts a year: May to August and December to March.
eligibility: For people who face underrepresentation, systemic bias or discrimination in the tech industry of their country.
opens: Twice a year: February and August. Check the official page for exact dates

title: MLH Fellowship
summary: A fully remote, 12-week internship alternative with a stipend. Fellows work on open source projects from corporate partners with mentorship from professional engineers.
eligibility: See the official FAQ and application page.
opens: Applications open for upcoming start dates. See the official page

title: Chevening Scholarships
summary: Fully funded one-year master's degree at a UK university for emerging leaders from around the world. There is no upper age limit.
eligibility: Each country has its own page with the eligibility rules and the exact deadline. Standard, SIDS and ASEAN variants exist.
opens: Opens in August and closes in October. The 2027/28 call closed in October 2026

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
summary: Funding for outstanding postgraduate students at the University of Cambridge who share a potential for social leadership.
eligibility: You must be a citizen of any country outside the United Kingdom and apply for a PhD, an MLitt or a one-year full-time postgraduate course. Undergraduate degrees are not considered.
opens: Open from September. The main round deadline is 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027, depending on your course

title: DAAD scholarships for study and research in Germany
summary: A database of 148 scholarship options for international students and researchers, from DAAD and other selected funding organisations.
eligibility: Eligibility depends on the country you live in and apply from. Each programme page names a contact person for the current terms.
opens: Every programme has its own deadline. Open the database and filter by your status and country

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
organization: European Education and Culture Executive Agency
summary: Joint master's programmes run by university consortia in Europe. Many programmes offer Erasmus Mundus scholarships, some do not.
eligibility: Master's level students from all over the world can apply. Contact the programme's consortium about courses, procedures and scholarship availability.
opens: Most programmes take applications between October and January. Each programme sets its own deadline

title: Stipendium Hungaricum
summary: Hungarian government scholarship. Tuition fees are covered and accommodation costs are supported. You can choose up to two programmes from more than 900 at 30 universities.
eligibility: Only programmes covered by the cooperation agreement between Hungary and your country. You must be nominated by your country's sending partner. Applications are free.
opens: One deadline each year in January (15 January 2026 for the 2026/27 call). Apply through your sending partner

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
organization: Fulbright Program, US Department of State
summary: Fulbright grants to study in the United States for people who are not US citizens.
eligibility: Apply through the Fulbright Commission or Foundation, or the US Embassy, in your home country. Deadlines differ by country.
opens: Set by your country's Fulbright Commission or US Embassy. Ask them for the current dates

title: D. E. Shaw Research summer internship
summary: Paid 12 to 15 week internship in New York for students in machine learning, computer science, electrical and computer engineering, applied math, physics and chemistry. Python or C/C++ experience is required. The page gives an expected monthly salary of 20,000 to 29,400 USD plus a housing allowance.
eligibility: Undergraduate and graduate students pursuing degrees in scientific and technical disciplines.
opens: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis for summer 2027. The page asks students to apply by the end of the fall semester

title: NVIDIA internships and Ignite
summary: Year-round internships of at least 12 weeks for BS, MS, PhD and MBA students, including roles in NVIDIA Research. Ignite is a 12-week summer pre-internship program for freshmen and sophomores.
eligibility: Current BS, MS, PhD and MBA students for internships, and current freshmen and sophomores for Ignite. Apply through NVIDIA's job portal.
opens: Internships are offered year-round and Ignite runs in the summer. No fixed deadline is listed

title: Microsoft Explore internship
summary: A 12-week summer internship created for first- and second-year college students.
eligibility: First- and second-year college students. Eligibility by country is on a separate page of the Microsoft careers site. Candidates submit a new application each year.
opens: Recruiters accept applications until all positions are filled. Most internships take place in the summer

title: Major League Hacking 2027 season: student hackathons
summary: 28 student hackathons from January to April 2027, all listed as in person. Examples: DeltaHacks (9 to 10 January, Hamilton), UofTHacks (15 to 17 January, Toronto), HackIllinois (26 to 28 February), LA Hacks (16 to 18 April).
eligibility: Each hackathon sets its own registration. Open the event page from the list.
opens: January to April 2027. Registration opens separately for each event

title: ETHGlobal hackathons
summary: Hackathons for people building on Ethereum. Next: ETHGlobal Mumbai, 5 to 7 November 2026, in person. This year's online events were HackMoney (30 January to 11 February), Open Agents (24 April to 6 May) and ETHOnline (4 to 16 September).
eligibility: Each event page has its own rules, prizes and application.
opens: Several events a year. See the events page for the next dates

title: Hack Club hackathons and game jams for teens
summary: Free community for teenagers with hackathons such as Undercity, a 4-day hardware hackathon in San Francisco, and Daydream, 100 high school game jams in 100 cities on the same weekend.
eligibility: For all teens aged 13 to 18. Free for every teenager.
opens: Events run throughout the year. See the site for what is happening now

title: A*STAR Graduate Scholarship (AGS)
summary: Up to 4 years of full tuition and a monthly allowance (3,600 SGD for international students in STEM, 5,000 SGD in semiconductor, quantum and computing), plus support for up to 12 months of overseas attachment.
eligibility: Open to all nationalities. International students must have completed or be on track to complete a bachelor's or master's degree at a Singapore autonomous university, with at least Second-Class (Upper) Honours or equivalent. Non-Singaporeans have a 3-year service commitment with a Singapore-based company.
opens: Two windows a year: from November to 1 February and from 1 June to 10 August. The opening date of the first window differs between sections of the page, so confirm it

title: Turkiye Scholarships
organization: YTB, Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities
summary: Competitive, merit-based scholarships for international students from all countries for associate, bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees, with university placement. Applications are free and made online.
eligibility: International students from all countries. See the announcement for the current call.
opens: The general application period on the official calendar runs from 10 January to 20 February (2026 call: 10 January to 20 February 2026)

title: Australia Awards Scholarships
summary: Full tuition, return air travel, an establishment allowance, health cover and a fortnightly living expense contribution for full-time study in Australia.
eligibility: For individuals from a selection of developing countries. The list of participating countries is on the DFAT website.
opens: The 2027 round was open from 1 February to 30 April 2026. Check the official page for the next round
